text:
lisa: Heads-up — saw ~18m propagation lag on a private VPC canary for customer acme-corp. Control plane showed rollout at 10% but traffic stayed on v1. Logs indicate agent fetch timeouts and queued bundles.
omar: Do you have the agent logs or rollout id?
lisa: rollouts/r-1234. snippet:
```text
2026-02-12T12:45:23Z agent[acme-vpc-12] WARN fetch: timeout=120s err=ECONNREFUSED
2026-02-12T12:45:25Z agent[acme-vpc-12] INFO enqueue bundle r-1234
2026-02-12T12:46:00Z control-plane INFO mark_applied customer=acme rollout=r-1234 state=enqueued
```
deploy-bot: Rollout started by lisa: /rollout start r-1234 canary=10%
kai: For air-gapped agents we use signed bundles that agent pulls on heartbeat. Looks like control plane currently treats queueing as success. That will surface as applied even if agent never acked.
maria: We should change semantics: only mark "applied" after agent ACK. Also expose propagation states in the console (queued/pushing/failed/acked). Right now UI is too optimistic.
omar: Agreed — UX should show an "expected propagation window" derived from last-heartbeat metrics and 95th percentile apply time for that customer. Makes it less surprising.
henry: Short-term patch: implement a push-kick API to nudge agents (where network allows). Example CLI:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.internal/push-kick" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"customer":"acme","rollout_id":"r-1234"}'
```
lisa: Also adding rollout.propagation.delay histogram + per-customer last_ack_age metric. Alert if >5m for canary >5% traffic.
kai: Security note — push-kick must be mutually authenticated and rate-limited. For fully air-gapped installs the control plane cannot reach agents; fallback is an operator-run local apply.
maria: Proposal for rollout guard: new guard "min-ack" that requires N agents or X% ack before increasing traffic. Default for private: 80%.
omar: Can we scope this into a 2-week sprint? Changing control-plane semantics, agent handshake, and a console change to show propagation state — rough estimate 2.5w.
lisa: I'll open a GH issue with a short design doc and link telemetry dashboards. Filing now. pinging @kai for agent handshake API design. :thumbsup:
